name: summarizer
description: Summarize text, articles, documents, or long content into concise key points. This skill should be used when condensing lengthy content, creating executive summaries, extracting the main takeaways from a document, or distilling research findings. Triggers: 'summarize this', 'give me the key points', 'TL;DR', 'what's the gist', 'condense this', 'executive summary of'.
